readme.note: Simulation demo: request/response + one-way relay pipeline, four nodes. 'Requester' sends a 'list' request to 'Responder', which uses a switch/case on the incoming value and, on 'list', looks up every BusinessCapability part via ctx.findParts and replies with ctx.response (delivered back to Requester one tick later, over the same connector — no reverse connector needed). Requester marks the request as answered in ctx.state so it never asks again, then sends a random capability to 'Relay' every 20 ticks (holding the same value between rotations). Relay dedupes by part id in ctx.state so it only forwards to 'Display' when a genuinely NEW part arrives — it also has to guard against Requester's earlier 'list' string still arriving on the same broadcast value, which is a real bug this file's script was caught making during testing (see Relay's comment). Display dedupes the same way and logs each new label via ctx.log. Step or Run Simulation, then watch the Message Log (left sidebar).

parts.label: Requester
parts.description: Requests the capability list once, then relays a random capability to Relay every 20 ticks.

parts.label: Responder
parts.description: Answers a 'list' request with every BusinessCapability part in this model.

parts.label: Relay
parts.description: Forwards a part to Display only when it differs from the last one received.

parts.label: Display
parts.description: Logs each newly-received part label to the Message Log.
